_what_this_is: Measured thresholds for the five-voter semantic ensemble (WORDS-A constraint 3). Every value is derived from measurement on real cases and is recorded with the error rate it produces. A voter with no entry does not vote, and the ensemble then refuses rather than proceeding with fewer than five.
_measurement: docs/fix/ENSEMBLE_THRESHOLDS.md carries the method and the full result. Leave-one-out over the operator's reference set (40 positive, 30 negative) plus all 44 shipped convention rules as additional true negatives: 114 cases in total.
_how_these_were_chosen: Not the midpoint of a minimum margin. That criterion was tried first and rejected: it is a worst-case measure, so a single pathological case sets it, and on this data it declared four of five voters uncalibratable while those voters in fact score a handful of errors each. Each threshold here minimises (false negatives + false positives) over all 124 cases. A three-times weighting on false negatives was tried second and also rejected by measurement: with the SBERT safety veto already guaranteeing no misses, weighting misses again drove every threshold down to catch cases the veto would have caught anyway and bought 8 to 12 false positives per voter to do it. The veto owns the false-negative side; each voter's threshold buys accuracy.
_do_not_round: These are not round numbers. Each is the measured cost-optimal cut point on real cases, and the error rate it produces is recorded beside it.

redaction_intent._measured_on: 40 positive references, 40 negative references (including 10 ordinary style and formatting rules), 44 shipped convention rules as additional true negatives: 124 cases

_sbert.note: the strongest voter, and the only one with no misses; it holds the safety veto

redaction_intent._zero_evidence_never_votes_yes: Independent of every threshold: a voter scoring exactly 0.0 has found no evidence either way and abstains into a no. Found by check 41, not by reasoning: the three-word fixture 'use formal register' scored 5 of 5 YES because three lexical voters scored 0.0 against thresholds at or below zero. A threshold governs how much evidence is enough, never whether none counts.

_ensemble_at_three_of_five.note: worse than sbert alone on this data, which is why the safety veto exists. With the veto: 0 false negatives. Recorded rather than hidden.

_safety_veto._what_this_is: A voter measured never to miss may overturn a NO, and may never overturn a YES. It can only ever ADD redaction, which is the conservative direction under LAW-IV. Every veto is recorded on the decision as `safety_veto`, so a reader always sees that the majority said no and why the answer is yes anyway.
_safety_veto._this_is_a_judgement_made_for_the_operat: It keeps WORDS-A's five-voter rule while refusing to let a measured-perfect voter be outvoted into the one error that matters. Revisit it if the measurement changes.

redaction_intent.reason: measured 0 false negatives in 40 true cases while the ensemble at three of five had 4; a false NO silently publishes content the operator marked for removal
redaction_intent._why_this_threshold_and_not_the_voter's_: The veto carries a HIGHER bar than sbert's ordinary 0.0165, measured separately. At the ordinary threshold the veto rescued 'Cite the edition used', an ordinary style rule, because a marginal dense score was enough to overturn a 2-of-5 no. A veto exists to rescue a rule the lexical voters could not see, not to overrule them where the dense voter is itself unsure.
redaction_intent._the_ranges_overlap_and_this_is_the_cons: The true cases needing a veto score +0.0392 to +0.1727; the style rules that must not be rescued reach +0.0810. These OVERLAP, so no cut separates them. 0.09 sits above every style rule, which means two weak true cases ('The medical history must not be included in the summary' at +0.0392 and 'Redact any comment that names an individual' at +0.0676) are not rescued BY THE VETO. They are still reached by the majority when their lexical voters fire. This is the conservative direction: it declines to widen what redaction acts on, and widening reach is the operator's call, not mine. Revisit with more reference text if the misses matter more than the widening.

shape_identifier._measured_on: 18 positive, 16 negative. No voter is clean: the three shapes overlap semantically (a 'reference number' is both an identifier and a number), so each voter carries 2 to 7 errors. This is UNIONED with the cue list rather than replacing it, so the ensemble only ever ADDS an authorisation.
shape_identifier._why_no_safety_veto: Measured: the veto threshold that would exclude every false case sits ABOVE the weakest true case, so a veto would rescue nothing it should and would rescue things it should not. Omitted rather than set to a number that does no work.
